Beim allerersten Öffnen fragt die Karte,:
The very first time, the card asks how you want to start: empty, with sample fines or with the file from “Alle Neune”.
Then add your people under “Members” and set the base fee and lane under ⚙️ → “Rules & amounts”. Done – good luck! 🎳
Reiter <b>„Abend“</b> → <b>„Kegelabend s:
Tab “Evening” → “Start bowling evening”. All members appear as tiles.
1. Who is there? The small button at the bottom of the tile switches: bowling → watching → excused → no-show.
2. Book a fine: tap the person (blue frame), then tap the fine. Every tap = +1. Mistyped? Undo in the black bar at the bottom or with − in the bill.
3. Done? “Close evening”. The bill shows who pays what – with a button to share it (e.g. to the WhatsApp group).
Im laufenden Abend <b>„＋ Gast“</b> antip: In the running evening tap “＋ Guest”: pick a known guest or type a new name. Guests follow the same rules as members. A guest who isn't there pays nothing – they aren't part of the evening.
Unter ⚙️ → <b>„Regeln &amp; Beträge“</b>:
Under ⚙️ → “Rules & amounts”:
• Base fee per person and evening (e.g. 7.50 €).
• Watchers pay the base fee (switch).
• Absent members pay the base fee (switch) – whether excused or not.
• No-show: extra amount on top (e.g. 5.00 €).
• Bowling lane: per hour, from the cash, split among those present or not at all.
Changes apply right away and to the running evening. Closed evenings stay as they were.
Reiter <b>„Mitglieder“</b> → Bereich <b>:
Tab “Members” → section Fines → ＋ New. Every fine has a name, icon, amount and “Who pays?”:
• The thrower – e.g. gutter ball, bell.
• All others who are bowling – e.g. all nine: whoever throws the nine pays nothing, all other bowlers pay. Watchers and absentees are spared.
Drag the handle ⠿ = order of the buttons on the evening.
Ausflug, Weihnachtsfeier, Geburtstag? Im: Trip, Christmas party, birthday? In the evening (or later in the list of evenings) turn on “Waive fines”: fines are still counted (for the statistics), but only the base fee is paid.
Reiter <b>„Kasse“</b>: oben der <b>Kasse:
Tab “Cash”: at the top the cash balance, below “Who owes what”. Someone paid: tap the green check ✓ – everything is settled (undo works for 8 seconds). Partial amount? Tap the person.
＋ Payment and − Expense (e.g. bowling trip, dinner) for everything else. The lane books itself depending on the setting.
“Target” = cash + what is still open.
Reiter <b>„Statistik“</b>: Jahr mit ‹ ›: Tab “Statistics”: pick the year with ‹ ›. At the top the kings (who has the most gutter balls, nines …), then fines per person (bars), fines by type (pie), cash over the year (line) and attendance.
Unten im Reiter „Abend“ stehen die letzt: At the bottom of the “Evening” tab you find the last evenings. Tap = view the bill, reopen (e.g. add a forgotten gutter ball), change the date or delete.
In der App „Alle Neune“ die Daten <b>exp:
In the “Alle Neune” app export the data (database file). Then here ⚙️ → “Import & backup” → choose the file. First you get a preview (how many evenings, people, bookings, cash balance), only “Apply” changes anything.
Taken over are members, former members, guests, fines with prices, all evenings with fines (for the statistics) and the complete cash. Old evenings don't count as “open” – they were already settled in the app. Games are not taken over.
⚙️ → „Import &amp; Sicherung“: <b>„Siche: ⚙️ → “Import & backup”: “Save backup” downloads everything as a file (.json). With the same file you get everything back later. The cash is also available as CSV for Excel.
Auf der Kegelbahn ist das WLAN oft schle:
At the bowling alley the Wi-Fi is often worse than the treasurer's gutter ball. That's why there is a small app of its own: address in ⚙️ → “Offline app”. Open it in the phone browser → sign in → “Add to home screen”.
Without network everything keeps working. What you enter waits in the outbox (“⏳ waiting” at the top) and is sent on its own later. Nothing counts twice – even if two phones book fines at the same time.
In ⚙️ unter <b>„Schutz“</b> legst du ein:
Under ⚙️ “Protection” you set a PIN (4–8 digits). Then ⚙️ and “Members” ask for it. Booking fines still works without the PIN. Optionally the PIN locks the whole card.
Forgot the PIN? An admin goes to Settings → Devices & services → Kegelclub → Configure and ticks “Reset PIN”. There you also find “Show in sidebar”.
<b>Einstellungen → Geräte &amp; Dienste: Settings → Devices & services → Kegelclub → Add entry and give it a name. Every club has its own members, fines, cash, PIN and sensors. In the card editor choose it under “Which club?”.
